key_insight: AI can unify noisy, multimodal evidence to diagnose, explain, predict, and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites.
engineering_relevance: This framework can guide more reliable perovskite device design by linking degradation mechanisms to actionable stability-enhancement strategies.
evidence_signal: The review highlights that instability studies are limited by sparse statistics, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, and uncertainty quantification challenges, motivating AI-based analysis across tasks.
watch_item: Model transferability is still constrained by inconsistent datasets, benchmark design, and varying experimental protocols.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
